2.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

3.en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
3.tj: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ٣

4.en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
4.tj: وَلَلْأَخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ٤

5.en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

6.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
6.tj: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔـاوَىٰ ٦

7.en: And He found you lost and guided [you],

8.en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

9.en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
9.tj: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ ٩

10.en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
10.tj: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ ١٠

11.en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
11.tj: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ١١
